senses.gloss:
mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Swift, quick, expeditious.
m. (-वः)
1 Speed, velocity.
2 A runner, an express.
f. (-वा)
The China rose, (Hibiscus rosa sinensis); also जपा.
E.
जु to move quickly, affix अच्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं)
Quick, fleet.
m. (-नः)
1 A courser, a fleet horse.
2 A country, Ionia or Greece: see यवन.
3 A native of that country.
4 A sort of deer.
n. (-नं)
Speed, velocity.
f. (-नी)
1 A screen surrounding a tent, a Kenāt.
2 A drug.
E.
जु to be quick, affix ल्युट् or युच्, and fem. ङीष् or टाप्.

n. (-लं)
A sort of grain, (Andropogon bicolor): see यवनाल.

f. (-का)
1 A wall or screen of cloth surrounding a tent, an outer tent, &c.
2 A curtain, a screen in general.
E.
कन् added to जवनी.

m. (-सः)
Meadow or pasture grass.
E.
जु to grow quick, असच् affix: see यवस.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Very quick.
m. (-कः)
A fleet horse, a courser.
E.
जव speed, and अधिक exceeding.

m. (-लः)
A gale, a hurricane.
E.
जव fleet, अनिल wind.

m. (-ष्पः)
The China rose, the plant or its flower.
E.
जवा as above, and पुष्प a flower.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Quick or fleet, expeditious.
m. (-वी)
1 A camel.
2 A horse.
E.
जव speed, इनि aff.
